fusions.name: Reel Yourself In
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line at a target up to 8 tiles away and hauls you to it. The hit deals 13 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tear the Barb Free
fusions.desc: Rips a barb out of the target, dealing 9 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Drag Line
fusions.desc: Snags a line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 4 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Snag the Next
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a barb flies to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
